settings.title: I haven’t received a tracking email. What should I do?
settings.answer: Tracking is sent when your order ships. Check your junk or spam folder and the email address you used at checkout. If you still can’t find it, send us a message with your order number.

settings.title: Can I change my delivery address or order?
settings.answer: If you need to change your delivery address, update an item or cancel your order, contact us as soon as possible with your order number and what you’d like to change. We can only make changes before our warehouse processes the order. Once it’s been processed, we can’t change the address, edit or cancel the order, or stop it from shipping.

settings.title: What if something arrives damaged, faulty or incorrect?
settings.answer: Email us with your order number, the product name and a short description of what happened. If your item arrived damaged, please include clear photos showing the damage so we can assess it.

settings.title: Can you help me choose a soft play set?
settings.answer: Of course. Tell us your little one’s age, the space you have available and any sets you’re considering, and we’ll help you narrow it down.
